did: Home's half of making cards essays spoken. Home's render job was already handing the essay recorder Kokoro's address, as the call's job does, so the voice needed only comments, docs and tests here; the lane's memory budget and class already counted the speaker. Then, at your ask, cards essays became a feed among the phone's episodes, each with its title, on the routes the other feeds use, and the contract rose to 10. Linking a YouTube URL and letting an essay's video go are left for their own story. Three independent reviews stood in for Codex; none was blocking.
